title: Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon
wikitext:
Assassinate the final Charr leader while Vael distracts the rest of the Charr camp. {{Quest infobox | map = [[image:Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon Map.jpg|250px]] | name = Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same
for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon | campaign = Eye of the North | region = Charr Homelands | type = Secondary | given by = [[Vael]] | given at = [[Sacnoth Valley]] | preceded by = [[Forbidden Fruit]] }} ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Wait by the entrance to the hierophant's stronghold for [[Vael]] to create a diversion. * Rush in while the Charr are distracted and kill [[Vyrrgis the Pestilent]]. * See [[Captain Langmar]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 150 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s * {{skill icon|Weakness Trap}} * [[Lockpick]] ==Walkthrough== Walk to the quest marker on your radar and wait for Vael to run past carrying '[[Grawl Pheromones]]'. He will be followed by a very large group of Grawl. Once the quest log updates, follow Vael's lead into the camp. Once inside, head straight to Vyrrgis and kill him. You shouldn't be attacked while the Charr and Grawl are occupied with each other. Once the foe is dead, you can simply zone back to Longeye's Ledge. == NPCs == === Allies === *{{a}} 20 [[Vael]] === Foes === [[Charr]] *{{w}}{{e}} 20 (26) [[Charr Axemaster]]s (2) *{{w}}{{e}} 20 (26) [[Charr Blademaster]]s (2) *{{mo}}{{Me}} 20 (26) [[Charr Prophet]]s (2) *{{n}}{{Rt}} 20 (26) [[Charr Hexreaper]] (2) *{{me}}{{Mo}} 20 (26) [[Charr Dominator]]s (2) *{{e}}{{Mo}} 20 (26) [[Charr Flameshielder]] (2) [[Grawl]] *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Grawl Champion]]s (3) *{{p}} 24 (26) [[Grawl Demagogue]] ==== Bosses ==== [[Charr]] *{{w}}{{e}} 24 (30) [[Gharaz the Glutton]] → [[Eviscerate]] (immediately after [[Forbidden Fruit]], if kept alive) *{{n}}{{rt}} 24 (30) [[Vyrrgis the Pestilent]] → [[Reaper's Mark]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Vael :''Well, it's time to clean up that last Charr leader I told you about. His name is [[Vyrrgis the Pestilent]] and he is one nasty beast. I've heard he prefers the tender bones of the young for a late afternoon snack. The Charr here know something is afoot after that whole poisoning incident, so we'll need to come up with something a bit more drastic to catch their attention. Don't worry. I've taken care of that part. Just wait for me near the hierophant's stronghold and, at the right moment, rush in there and take Vyrrgis down. You'll know the [[Grawl|diversion]] when you see it, believe me.'' {{offer dialog |accept = Diversion, schmiversion. Let's kill some Charr. |decline = Suddenly, I find I don't believe you quite as much. |ask = Go. Get into position near the entrance to the hierophant's stronghold and wait for my [[Grawl|diversion]]. You'll know it when you see it. |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Captain Langmar :''Ha ha ha! What great fun. Remind me to ask Vael where he got all those Grawl pheromones... On second thought, I don't want to know.'' ==Notes== *The Grawl will be hostile to both the Charr and to you. *You can pick up the [[Grawl Pheromones]] afterwards, but it will no longer have any effect. ==Trivia== *This quest has the longest quest name in the game. *The name of this quest is a parody of dating ads.
